## About
Weber Autowerks is a local, family-owned auto shop in San Antonio. We take care of routine maintenance, air conditioning, diesel performance and repair, engine and transmission work, and fleet vehicles.
Our fully licensed technicians aim to get the job done right the first time, and our shop is insured and bonded for your protection. We serve drivers from Garden Ridge, Schertz, Cibolo, Selma, San Antonio and the surrounding areas.
Customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 224 Google reviews. Give us a call or come see us on 5th St.

## Services
- Routine maintenance: Engine diagnostics, brakes and tune-ups, electrical work, oil changes, spark plugs, and radiator flush and fill.
- Air conditioning services: Evacuate and recharge, resistor replacements, evaporator core and blower motor repairs and replacements, and complete AC system replacements.
- Engine and transmission work: From engine rebuilds to engine replacements, plus transmission work.
- Diesel performance and repair: Repair and performance work for diesel vehicles.
- Fleet services: Repairs for your business's fleet vehicles, with help choosing the right parts from brands like BG Products.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or stop by the shop and we'll give you an estimate.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Garden Ridge, Schertz, Cibolo, Selma, San Antonio and the surrounding areas.
